result:
I wrote the plan for w198 and set the outcome to `DONE`, with no questions. There is nothing to make green. The research ran the 11 tests of the four accepted requirements (supervision r75, r105, r120 and r121) and all of them already pass. The work is only removing the seven deprecated scenarios the work-item lists to retire.

- **How they go:** the implementer removes each one with `features retire`, one title at a time, not by editing the feature files. The tests generated from those scenarios disappear with them. The check that each scenario has exactly one test (`test_bound.py`) stays green.
- **Two step definitions removed:** retiring the scenarios leaves two step definitions that nothing else uses:
  - `other_initiative` in `tests/scenarios/supervision_integrate_steps.py`, used only by the deprecated r102 scenario.
  - `drafted` in `tests/scenarios/test_work_queue.py`, used only by the deprecated work-queue r1 scenario.

  No check would catch them, because vulture runs at a confidence threshold that skips unused functions, so the plan has them removed. That adds those two files to the researcher's three feature files. Every other step in the retired scenarios is still used by a live scenario.
- **No changes to the scripts:** no existing test needs rewriting.
- **Left out of scope:** the research found three bugs that would change what the person running `work run` sees, and this work-item covers none of them:
  - a branch review's fix loop has no limit (a probe ran 198 rounds before it was killed);
  - a review question given as one string instead of a list is dropped;
  - an analysis that ran out of turns is never retried.

  The plan has the implementer report them for a follow-up rather than fix them here.

Files are in `.shop/scratch/2-plan/`:
- plan.md
- result.json
